description: Find places by what they are and where they are, such as bakeries in Curitiba. Places we saved from earlier searches come back at once, for free. If they do not fill `limit`, a collection starts to find the rest and the answer includes it: each new place costs one credit as it arrives, and it stops at `limit`, so a search never costs more than `limit` credits. Search again later, or read the collection, to get the new ones; with `wait`, the answer waits up to 60 seconds for them. Needs an API key.

geo.description: Where to search. Give exactly one of: a Brazilian city as location, a lat/lng point with radiusM, a bbox, or a cityIbge with radiusKm.

keywords.description: What to search for, such as ["bakery"]. One search per term.

lang.description: The language to search in. New places come back in it. Two letters, such as pt or en.

limit.description: How many places you want, from 1 to 120. Also the most a search can cost.

minRating.description: Keep only places rated at least this, from 1 to 5. Null keeps every place.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for new places when we have to collect them, up to 60. 0 answers at once with what we already have.

name: search_places
title: Search for places
